# Grace Li

**Audio Realism Benchmark: Measuring Realism in Audio Models** \\
\\
Today we’re introducing Audio Realism Bench, our benchmark for AI conversational realism.\\
\\
Modern TTS has saturated the traditional 1–5 mean opinion score (MOS) and while it is able to capture intelligibility and naturalness, it no longer meaningfully separates frontier systems that all produce clean speech.\\
\\
Audio Realism Bench](https://notes.designarena.ai/audio-realism-benchmark-measuring-realism-in-audio-models/)[![Kimi K3’s Design Secret may be in its Thinking Traces](https://storage.ghost.io/c/c3/d9/c3d943c7-9537-4835-837f-b707f6264237/content/images/size/w600/2026/10/Kimi-K3-Post-Cover--1-.png)\\
**Kimi K3’s Design Secret may be in its Thinking Traces** \\
\\
Kimi K3, Moonshot AI’s latest open-weight1 model, ranks 1st on our single-shot Frontend Arena with an Elo of 1392. **Thinking Machines’ Open Weights Model is Now on Design Arena** \\
\\
We are excited to introduce Inkling, Thinking Machines' first model - and it’s open weights. With this release, Thinking Machines establishes itself as a top 6 lab in agentic workloads. Inkling is the top US-based open weights model, representing a step forward for the open source ecosystem as](https://notes.designarena.ai/thinking-machines-open-weights-model-is-now-on-design-arena/)[![How OpenAI’s Sol Finally Learned Design Taste](https://storage.ghost.io/c/c3/d9/c3d943c7-9537-4835-837f-b707f6264237/content/images/size/w600/2026/10/OpenAI-Sol-Taste-Cover--3-.png)\\
**How OpenAI’s Sol Finally Learned Design Taste** \\
\\
We benchmarked GPT-5.6 Sol on Design Arena’s Web Design (Non-Agentic) Arena, and we were surprised to find that it ranks 1st overall. This is 18 places higher than its predecessor GPT-5.5, and is the first time an OpenAI model has placed first on this](https://notes.designarena.ai/how-openais-sol-finally-learned-design-taste/)[![What we've learned from 50,000+ AI slides generations… open sourced for you today](https://storage.ghost.io/c/c3/d9/c3d943c7-9537-4835-837f-b707f6264237/content/images/size/w600/2026/07/slides-.jpeg)\\
**What we've learned from 50,000+ AI slides generations… open sourced for you today** \\
\\
We've seen a massive uptick in demand for AI-generated slides at DesignArena - it’s become one of our fastest-growing creation categories.\\
\\
The harness-level implementation of slides is nuanced and often overlooked. We’ve generated over 50K slides now and have experimented with every harness possibility…](https://notes.designarena.ai/what-weve-learned-from-50-000-ai-slides-generations-open-sourced-for-you-today-2/)[![Gemini Omni Flash: A Video Model for Directors](https://storage.ghost.io/c/c3/d9/c3d943c7-9537-4835-837f-b707f6264237/content/images/size/w600/2026/10/Gemini-Omni-Flash.png)\\
**Gemini Omni Flash: A Video Model for Directors** \\
\\
We benchmarked Gemini Omni Flash on Video Generation, and it took first place by 102 Elo points. Gemini Omni Flash ranks 1st overall on Design Arena’s Video Arena evaluation, 7 places higher than its highest-performing predecessor Veo 3 Fast. To do so, it surpassed the Seedance 2.0](https://notes.designarena.ai/gemini-omni-flash-a-video-model-for-directors/)[![How GLM-5.2 Beat Fable 5 at Website Design](https://storage.ghost.io/c/c3/d9/c3d943c7-9537-4835-837f-b707f6264237/content/images/size/w600/2026/10/GML-5.2.png)\\
**How GLM-5.2 Beat Fable 5 at Website Design** \\
\\
GLM 5.2 ranks 1st overall on Design Arena’s single-turn, HTML Web Design (Non-Agentic) evaluation, 5 places higher than its predecessor GLM-5.1. To do so, it beat Claude Fable 5, Opus 4.6, and Opus 4.7, a model line that has held the top](https://notes.designarena.ai/how-glm-5-2-beat-fable-5-at-website-design/)[![Opus 4.8’s Hyperfocus on Agents is Making It Worse at Design](https://storage.ghost.io/c/c3/d9/c3d943c7-9537-4835-837f-b707f6264237/content/images/size/w600/2026/06/Screen-Shot-2026-06-12-at-3.33.48-PM.png)\\
**Opus 4.8’s Hyperfocus on Agents is Making It Worse at Design** \\
\\
We benchmarked Opus 4.8 on single-turn Web Dev, and we found something rather surprising… it performs significantly worse compared to Opus 4.7, and all other Anthropic models for that matter.\\
\\
Rather shockingly, Claude Opus 4.8 ranks 23rd overall on Design Arena’s Web Dev (Non-Agentic)](https://notes.designarena.ai/opus-4-8s-hyperfocus-on-agents-is-making-it-worse-at-design/)[**Reve 2.0 establishes Reve as the top independent foundation image model lab** \\

We are excited to introduce Reve 2.0 – Reve’s most capable image generation model to date. With this release, Reve becomes the highest-ranked independent foundation image model lab on Design Arena.\\
\\
Utilizing a new layout architecture, Reve 2.0 advances the field of AI-powered creativity with native](https://notes.designarena.ai/reve-2-0-establishes-reve-as-the-top-independent-foundation-image-model-lab/)[![Ideogram 4.0 Is Now the Frontier Open Image Model For Design](https://storage.ghost.io/c/c3/d9/c3d943c7-9537-4835-837f-b707f6264237/content/images/size/w600/2026/06/ImageArticle.png)\\
**Ideogram 4.0 Is Now the Frontier Open Image Model For Design** \\
\\
Data updated on June 8th, 2026.\\
\\
We are excited to announce that Ideogram 4.0, Ideogram’s most powerful image generation model to-date, is the frontier open-image model for image design.\\
\\
Designed with creative workflows in mind, Ideogram 4.0 brings a new level of capability to the](https://notes.designarena.ai/ideogram-4-0-is-now-the-frontier-open-image-model-for-design/)[![Evaluating Mobile App-Building Agents](https://storage.ghost.io/c/c3/d9/c3d943c7-9537-4835-837f-b707f6264237/content/images/size/w600/2026/02/daisy_field-1.png)\\
**Evaluating Mobile App-Building Agents** \\
\\
As coding agents mature, evaluation has become a core bottleneck. Design Arena’s core goal is to find the edges of model capability by evaluating agents on real-world application building, not toy tasks. We’ve seen models steadily improving quality and reliability in our React/web arena. To keep](https://notes.designarena.ai/evaluating-mobile-app-building-agents/)[![Fullstack Arena Methodology](https://storage.ghost.io/c/c3/d9/c3d943c7-9537-4835-837f-b707f6264237/content/images/size/w600/2026/02/Design-Arena-Image--21--1-1.png)\\
**Fullstack Arena Methodology** \\
\\
Real-World Full-Stack Web Application Benchmarking\\
\\
This platform tests whether AI coding agents can autonomously build complete, production-grade full-stack web applications with real persistent databases. Each model receives a user prompt describing an application, and must independently design a database schema, seed it with realistic data, build](https://notes.designarena.ai/fullstack-arena-methodology/)[![Founding Launch Designer](https://storage.ghost.io/c/c3/d9/c3d943c7-9537-4835-837f-b707f6264237/content/images/size/w600/2026/01/Pasted-Graphic-3.png)\\
**Founding Launch Designer** \\
\\
What if you got to announce the moments that define a new era of intelligence?\\
\\
When Christopher broke Enigma, when Deep Blue beat Kasparov, when AlphaGo beat Lee Sedol—these weren't promotional moments.\\
\\
They were the world discovering what our machines could do, in large part because someone](https://notes.designarena.ai/founding-launch-designer/)[![Design Arena Methodology](https://storage.ghost.io/c/c3/d9/c3d943c7-9537-4835-837f-b707f6264237/content/images/size/w600/2025/12/Screenshot-2025-12-09-at-12.21.26---PM.png)\\
**Design Arena Methodology** \\
\\
Leaderboard\\
\\
Rankings emerge from collective community preferences rather than curated opinions. Each pairwise comparison is weighted equally.\\
\\
The Elo score is approximated through the Bradley-Terry model. The model estimates each model's inherent strength through an iterative algorithm that converges when strength estimates stabilize (threshold: 0.0001) or](https://notes.designarena.ai/methodology/)[![Agent Runner: A Standard, Open-Source Agent Harness for Evaluating Real-World Coding Agents](https://storage.ghost.io/c/c3/d9/c3d943c7-9537-4835-837f-b707f6264237/content/images/size/w600/2025/11/Screenshot-2025-11-24-at-3.12.08---PM.png)\\
**Agent Runner: A Standard, Open-Source Agent Harness for Evaluating Real-World Coding Agents** \\
\\
As LLM-based coding agents mature, evaluation has become a core bottleneck. Existing benchmarks largely rely on static tasks and capture only the model’s final output, not the intermediate reasoning steps or tool interactions that define modern agentic systems. To study these systems rigorously, we need instrumentation that reflects](https://notes.designarena.ai/introwhite-label-agent-harness/)[![How Microsoft Research Asia used Design Arena to validate their aesthetic coding benchmark](https://storage.ghost.io/c/c3/d9/c3d943c7-9537-4835-837f-b707f6264237/content/images/size/w600/2025/11/Screenshot-2025-11-10-at-11.57.46---PM.png)\\
**How Microsoft Research Asia used Design Arena to validate their aesthetic coding benchmark** \\
\\
We recently added AesCoder-4B to Design Arena: a new model trained by a team from Microsoft Research Asia. AesCoder-4B is comparatively tiny at just 4 billion parameters, but as of the time of this writing, it is beating several flagship models in the Website rankings, including Gemini 2.](https://notes.designarena.ai/how-microsoft-research-asia-used-design-arena-to-validate-their-aesthetic-coding-benchmark/)[![Introducing Micro Evals](https://storage.ghost.io/c/c3/d9/c3d943c7-9537-4835-837f-b707f6264237/content/images/size/w600/2025/10/design-arena-design-arena--1-.png)\\
**Introducing Micro Evals** \\
\\
An overview of our live skills assessment methodology.\\
\\
What are Micro Evals?\\
\\
The current bottleneck in model progress isn’t figuring out how to improve models—it’s knowing what needs improvement. Creating realistic coding tasks for training or RL environments is difficult when you don’t know where models](https://notes.designarena.ai/introducing-micro-evals/)[![In pursuit of a benchmark for human taste](https://storage.ghost.io/c/c3/d9/c3d943c7-9537-4835-837f-b707f6264237/content/images/size/w600/2025/10/design-arena-design-arena--9-.png)\\
**In pursuit of a benchmark for human taste** \\
\\
We know when we like something, but when asked why, we stumble over our words and hallucinate reasoning. We contradict ourselves—we don’t know why we like a thing, we just do.\\
\\
There exist people who understand our preferences better than we do ourselves. Let’s call them Tastemakers.](https://notes.designarena.ai/in-pursuit-of-a-benchmark-for-human-taste/)[![The prompt is not the picture](https://storage.ghost.io/c/c3/d9/c3d943c7-9537-4835-837f-b707f6264237/content/images/size/w600/2025/10/Screenshot-2025-10-06-at-2.01.03---AM.png)\\
**The prompt is not the picture**\\
\\
“When an artist uses a conceptual form of art, it means that all of the planning and decisions are made beforehand and the execution is a perfunctory affair. The idea becomes a machine that makes the art.”\\
\\
– Sol LeWitt, Paragraphs on Conceptual Art (1966)](https://notes.designarena.ai/the-prompt-is-not-the-picture/)
